title: Conversion
description: Markdown made of an extraction, block by block, each Markdown block naming the blocks of the extraction it was made from (docs/adr/0026-a-conversion-is-held-to-the-original-block-by-block.md). SCE checks the citation: what matched, what is not in the original and what the conversion left out are SCE's counts, and the form has no field in which a conversion could say it is complete. The extraction it is of is named by its revision, the SHA-256 of its canonical text.

cites.description: The ids of the blocks of the extraction this block was made from, in the order they are read. A block that cites none is not in the original.

picture.description: The NAME of the picture a model read this block from; the block cites the one figure block that marks it, and the check queues it as read from a picture. Absent for a block written from the words of the original.

unsure.description: The model said it was not sure of what it read here. Only on a block read from a picture.

readings.description: One entry for each picture a model read: which figure block marks it, the picture as it was handed over (by SHA-256), and which runtime, model and recipe read it. Absent when no picture was read, so a conversion by rule keeps its revision.

unreadable.description: The places the model said it could not read, in its words. Nothing is guessed for them.
